intent: EvoPilot release repair, correctness repair, and documentation synchronization: fix the post-publication npm verifier bug, separate the npm GitHub Environment from the GitHub Release and GHCR environment, keep existing release authority without duplicate approval, restore future adapter provenance metadata, and correct stale v4.0.0 public release metadata without changing product capability, boundary, version, or published product bytes.
objective: Make EvoPilot's GitHub deployment and release surfaces truthful, channel-specific, and self-verifying while preserving the already accepted and published v4.0.0 artifacts and keeping evopilot-harness unchanged.

evidence.authority: explicit direction to prepare and execute the governed maintenance change; not approval of this exact Target revision or separate external release actions
observed post-publication verifier failure evidence; npm publication itself completed
public release-surface evidence showing stale candidate wording
comparison evidence for channel-specific GitHub Environments only; does not authorize evopilot-harness mutation or wholesale lifecycle copying
completed v4.0.0 product Target and acceptance baseline; this maintenance Target must not reopen or reinterpret it

include: Change the EvoPilot npm publication workflow to use a dedicated GitHub Environment named npm while retaining release for GitHub Release and GHCR promotion
Enforce the release/npm Environment split in deterministic release-pipeline contract checks and tests
Make the public npm installation verifier safe when a child process inherits stdio and therefore returns no captured string
Add repository, bugs, and homepage metadata to both adapter package manifests so a future version can publish normal npm provenance without repeating the v4.0.0 exception
Synchronize README, distribution operations, release management, and v4.0.0 release notes with the actual published v4.0.0 state

After separate external-action authorization, create the npm GitHub Environment with a main-only deployment policy and no duplicate required reviewer, configure its NPM_TOKEN secret, and preserve the existing release Environment
After separate external-action authorization, update only the v4.0.0 GitHub Release body from the verified checked-in release notes without moving the tag or replacing assets
Run complete local validation and public readback checks, with bounded automatic recovery for deterministic mechanics failures
exclude: Any evopilot-harness source, workflow, Roadmap, Target, artifact, Environment, deployment, package, or release mutation
Any EvoPilot product Lifecycle Harness behavior, API, Engine, schema, runtime, reference lifecycle, Candidate, E2E, acceptance, or product-version change
Rebuilding, repacking, republishing, deprecating, or changing the integrity of any public EvoPilot v4.0.0 npm package or release asset
Creating an npm-bootstrap Environment because all six EvoPilot packages already have an established public package history
Adding a second manual reviewer gate to the npm Environment
Changing credentials, repository permissions, branch protection, production systems, databases, deployments, tags, GHCR bytes, or npm package bytes outside the separately authorized exact actions
Force push, tag movement, asset deletion or overwrite, npm publication, new Candidate construction, or release of a new version

realCaseCoverage.scenario: From a clean EvoPilot checkout, validate the channel-split workflows and verifier, then after separate authorization configure the npm Environment and update the existing GitHub Release body, ending with public readbacks and no package publication.
realCaseCoverage.startingState: EvoPilot v4.0.0 is already published; the npm workflow uses release, its final verifier is red after successful publication, and public documentation contains stale candidate wording.
realCaseCoverage.terminalState: Local checks pass; release and npm Environments are distinct; the v4.0.0 public Release and documentation are truthful; all existing package and asset bytes remain unchanged.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Clean local validation, workflow contract tests, verifier regression test, package metadata assertions, exact public npm integrity readback, GitHub Environment policy readback, GitHub Release body readback, and before/after tag and asset identity

acceptance.criterion: The npm workflow uses only the npm GitHub Environment, the GitHub Release and GHCR workflow uses only release, and deterministic checks reject future channel conflation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Workflow diff, release-pipeline verification, and positive and negative contract tests

acceptance.criterion: The npm public-registry verifier completes when install and CLI subprocesses inherit stdio, while retaining integrity and executable-entry checks.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Focused regression test plus fresh temporary public-install verification
